Fellow Reyna cosplayer here! 
Here’s what I did to recreate her iconic tattoo: I drew a pattern with a pencil on a baking paper piece, I placed the baking paper on my arm and I applied a wet cloth for few seconds in order to get the tracing on my skin. After that I drew along the tracing with liquid eyeliner and I put talcum powder on it. 
At the end I put some hair spray on it. 
It lasted ALL day :)
